content.comment_body: Hello [product_name] users, When uploading a datalog file from a [product_name], the way the CSV file appears in Excel is influenced by your Windows regional settings and potentially those in Excel itself. If all data appears in a single column, it means Excel does not recognize the column separator used in the file. In [product_name] configuration software [version_no], a new option allows you to resolve this issue. You can go to: + Tools + Option + CSV separator and select "Semicolon" (commonly used in Germany). After changing this setting, datalog files you upload will display data correctly across columns in Excel when opened directly. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The conversation addresses an issue where CSV files exported from [product_name] configuration software may not display properly in Excel because of mismatched separator settings determined by regional configurations in Windows or Excel. The latest version of the configuration software introduces a manual CSV separator option, which enhances compatibility and improves user experience, especially in regions where semicolons are the standard separator.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that datalog files exported from [product_name] configuration software open in Excel with data correctly separated into columns, regardless of their Windows or Excel regional settings.
